name: aladdin.shadows
description: Elevation is primarily tonal layering; shadow is restrained. Only two shadow tokens exist by design.
maintenance: Manually maintained. Edit here first, then DESIGN.md (Elevation & Depth) and frontend/tailwind.config.ts (theme.extend.boxShadow).

card.usage: Raised cards on the light (Limestone/Plaster) theme; real offset + blur.

glow.usage: The Lumen bloom at the Aperture focal point and AI moments ONLY. Never a flat zero-offset halo on generic elements.

rules.tonal-first: On dark, build depth with layered stone surfaces (Basalt -> Basalt 2 -> Basalt 3) and border shifts before reaching for shadow. Reserve glow for Lumen focal moments.
